long, straight hair in a deep jet-black shade with hime-cut bangs. Narrow, piercing eyes in a vivid crimson shade. Appears as a youthful adolescent with a mischievous, cat-like expression. Petite, lithe build. A dark Gothic-style dress in a palette of obsidian black and deep violet. Features two black feline ears protruding from the hair and a long, slender black feline tail.
BODY COLOR: pale alabaster
